title: Existence of normalized comparisons for a fixed sectionwise scalar model
statement: For every scheme T and every fixed model m : SectionModel a T, there exist ordinary and derived comparisons whose packaged ScalarSectionData is ScalarSectionNormalized a T.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_section_comparisons_exists (T : Scheme.{u})
    (model : SectionModel a T) :
    ∃ ordinary : QuotientChange.extension a T ⋙
        (equivalence Λ' T).functor ≅
      (equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ model.E,
      ∃ derived : D a T ⋙ derivedFunctor Λ' T ≅
        derivedFunctor Λ T ⋙ model.T,
        ScalarSectionNormalized a T
          { model := model, ordinary := ordinary, derived := derived }
